title: consider restoring 1.3's "begin_nested() returns root transaction" for non-future mode

labels.name: engine
labels.description: engines, connections, transactions, isolation levels, execution options

labels.name: regression
labels.description: something worked and was broken by a change

body:
**Describe the bug**


If I use `Connection.begin_nested()` as a contextmanager inside an implicit transaction, I would expect that the outer implicit transaction shoudl be committed after the savepoint is released.

However, the savepoint is released as expected and then the transaction is rolled back.

This is a regression in 1.4.x - my snippet below works fine in 1.3.23.

**To Reproduce**

Here I inserted a row inside a `begin_nested` contextmanager. This is the only thing in the transaction. I would expect that the transaction is then committed.

I then use a separate connection to verify that the original transaction was committed - and it wasn't! Log output shows that the original transaction was rolled back instead.


```python
>>> import logging
>>> logging.getLogger('sqlalchemy.engine').setLevel(logging.INFO)
>>>
>>> with engine.connect() as conn:
...     with conn.begin_nested():
...         conn.execute("insert into testtable (txt) values ('it worked!');")
... with engine.connect() as conn:
...     if conn.scalar("select txt from testtable limit 1") is None:
...         print("it didn't work! no such row")
...
...
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): BEGIN (implicit)
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): SELECT 1
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): [cached since 2.302s ago] {}
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): COMMIT
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): BEGIN (implicit)
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_1
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): [no key 0.00055s] {}
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): insert into testtable (txt) values ('it worked!');
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): [raw sql] {}
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): RELEASE SAVEPOINT sa_savepoint_1
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): [no key 0.00058s] {}
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): ROLLBACK
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): BEGIN (implicit)
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): SELECT 1
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): [cached since 2.311s ago] {}
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): COMMIT
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): select txt from testtable limit 1
kx[1339.140185600350016]: INFO: sqlalchemy.engine.Engine base(132): [raw sql] {}
it didn't work! no such row
```


**Versions.**
 - OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS
 - Python: 2.7.17
 - SQLAlchemy: 1.4.12
 - Database: `PostgreSQL 10.16 (Debian 10.16-1.pgdg100+1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 8.3.0-6) 8.3.0, 64-bit`
 - DBAPI: psycopg2 `2.8.6 (dt dec pq3 ext lo64)`
